millard/oak-city.title: 2025 election cancelled; three candidates elected unopposed
millard/oak-city.summary: The June 8, 2025 town filing notice names Kirt Lambert Dutson for mayor and Thomas S. Nielson, David K. Steele, and Shawn Owen Gonder for two four-year council seats. Millard County records Steele’s withdrawal on August 11, 2025. Signed Resolution 2025-06, adopted September 18, 2025, cancels the November 4 election and certifies Dutson, Nielson, and Gonder elected unopposed to four-year terms beginning January 2026. The resolution spells Gonder’s first name “Sean”; the town filing notices and county declaration/finance listings use “Shawn”, retained here. No vote totals are implied by the cancellation.
